title: Pre-registered validation gates incl. demotion gate
pre_registration_note: Committed BEFORE engine/backtest.py is first run (see git history). Gate thresholds are project-defined policy choices, not official NFL rules; this is flagged.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: Staking claims require n >= 100 settled bets; signal claims require n >= 80 settled forecasts.

gates.name: Signal skill
gates.rule: The strategy's pre-declared signal metric must beat its pre-declared baseline with a 95% interval excluding the baseline (accuracy vs 0.500 via Wilson interval; MAE via paired comparison).

gates.name: No leakage
gates.rule: Look-ahead perturbation: mutating results of games after cutoff T must change 0 predictions made before T.

gates.name: Luck removal (placebo)
gates.rule: Run >= 500 placebo strategies (random side picks under the same price and sample). The strategy's staking ROI must beat the 95th percentile of the placebo ROI distribution (one-sided placebo p < 0.05).

gates.name: Staking confidence
gates.rule: The 95% CI for staking ROI must exclude 0 on the negative side (lower bound > 0) on the settled sample.

gates.name: Parlay dependence
gates.rule: Parlay legs must come from different games. Same-game legs require a dependence-adjusted price, which cannot be verified without official prices.

gates.name: Market verification (fair vs market)
gates.rule: Requires an official source of market open/close lines to compare against the model's fair line. No official NFL odds source exists.
gates.blocked_reason: The NFL publishes no betting lines; every market cell in this project is blank + flagged (FB-01).

gates.name: Prospective confirmation
gates.rule: At least one full week of forward (post-registration) evaluation with no changes to the strategy rule.
gates.status: pending — Week 11 not yet played at publication

demotion_gate.name: Live-to-paper demotion gate
demotion_gate.rule: Any strategy holding LIVE status is demoted back to PAPER status immediately when ANY of the following is true: (a) over any rolling window of 100 settled bets the upper bound of the 95% CI of ROI is below 0; (b) its G2 signal metric underperforms its declared baseline in 2 consecutive weekly evaluations; (c) a high-severity data-integrity flag is opened against an input it depends on; or (d) its G7 market-verification requirement becomes satisfiable and the strategy then fails fair-vs-market comparison. Demotion requires no human approval; re-promotion to LIVE requires passing G1-G6 and G8 afresh on data not used to design the strategy.
demotion_gate.current_applications: No strategy currently holds LIVE status (all PAPER or BLOCKED), so D1 has not fired. D1 is wired so that any future promotion is automatically reversible.

promotion_rule: PAPER -> LIVE only after passing G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6 (as applicable) and G8. G7 remains blocked for all strategies until an official price source exists.
